comment: Admission gates for a public preview. Machine-readable on purpose: a checklist a person ticks is a checklist that gets ticked. `sciwhisper-eval gate` reads this file and a report, and exits non-zero unless every required gate passes.
principles: A gate is judged on the bound, not on the point estimate. 90% of 20 examples is not 90%; the confidence interval says what the data can support, and that is what the gate reads.

A gate whose precondition is unmet is NOT passed. It is reported as not measurable, and that blocks the release exactly like a failure — otherwise a number measured on written text would be read as a claim about speech.
A rate observed as zero is judged on its upper bound. Zero false rewrites in 28 sentences is compatible with a 10% true rate, and shipping on that would be claiming something nobody measured.

gates.title: Точность итоговой вставки не ниже 90%
gates.rationale: The roadmap criterion for 0.5. Measured before OS insertion, which is what the harness can see; the Word path is covered by the manual protocol instead.

gates.title: Точность смешанной вставки пользовательского пути не ниже 90%
gates.rationale: Exercises `interpret_utterance` in MixedText, the path the desktop application actually inserts. AST records derive the expected Unicode document from their hand-written gold tree; raw records either stay unchanged or carry an explicit mixed-document expectation. A lab-only exact match cannot substitute for this gate.

gates.title: Precision автоматической вставки не ниже 97%
gates.rationale: Of everything the system inserted without asking, how much was right. This is the number a user experiences as trust, and it is deliberately stricter than overall accuracy: abstaining is cheap, being confidently wrong is not.

gates.title: Обычный текст не превращается в формулу — в том коде, который выполняется у пользователя
gates.rationale: Measured on `interpret_utterance` in MixedText — the path `pipeline.rs` runs — because that is what a user experiences. The lab path is gated separately below; a release may not pass on the parser's number while the shipped code behaves differently. The upper bound, not the count: an observed zero is not evidence of safety until the sample is large enough for the bound to mean something.

gates.title: Обычный текст не превращается в формулу — в разборе
gates.rationale: The same question asked of `interpret`, which is what the candidate generator calls. Kept as its own gate rather than merged: the two measure different code, and a single number would hide which one moved.

gates.title: Ни одной ошибки класса S4
gates.rationale: S4 is ordinary speech turned into a formula nobody dictated. One is too many, and unlike a rate this is a count: it is checked exactly.

gates.title: Всё вставленное структурно валидно
gates.rationale: An insertion that is not a well-formed AST is a defect regardless of whether it matches the corpus, and it is the one class of failure that cannot be blamed on recognition.

gates.title: Ни семейство, ни диктор не пересекают split
gates.rationale: A family or a speaker in two splits turns the benchmark into a memory test. Checked on whatever corpus the report was produced from, frozen or not.
